title: Companion stale profile reply isolation
description: Use the private gateway reply-delay fixture and prepared native profile state. No session is launched.

ready.intent: The native setup form is connected before testing reply races.

claude.intent: Choose the runner whose two native configurations are prepared.

profiles.intent: The selected runner has loaded its existing configurations.

show-authenticated.intent: Reach the authenticated configuration before delaying its status reply.

arm-status.intent: Delay the next actual mobile login-status response, without changing its payload.

authenticated.intent: Select the existing native configuration and begin its real login check.

status-held.intent: The gateway has produced the old configuration response and holds its delivery.

show-other.intent: Reach the signed-out configuration while the earlier response remains pending.

other.intent: Choose a different configuration before the old status arrives.

release-status.intent: The delayed authenticated response must not replace or enable the signed-out choice.

show-refresh.intent: Reach profile refresh for the inventory race.

arm-list.intent: Delay the next actual mobile profile inventory response.

refresh.intent: Start a real inventory refresh for the current runner.

list-held.intent: The gateway holds the completed old inventory response.

show-codex.intent: Reach another runner while the old inventory is pending.

codex.intent: Change runner before the earlier profile inventory arrives.

release-list.intent: The delayed inventory must preserve the new runner and its configuration choices.

capture.intent: Record the final runner selection after both actual response races.

choices-pending.intent: Other configurations remain available while the selected login check is pending.

other-selected.intent: The alternate configuration selection takes effect before the old response arrives.
